rationale: Materiality was supplied and limited to held BDCs; drafted a client note with only cited accession and row evidence for Priya approval.
text:
Active mandate confirmed: mandate_a (Harbor State Employees' Retirement System). Draft note for Priya approval:

Subject: HSERS monthly BDC credit note draft

Harbor State holds three BDCs in scope: FIXTURE GOLF CAPITAL CORP, FIXTURE HOTEL SENIOR LENDING, and FIXTURE JULIETT LENDING BDC.

This month, new filing-based credit pressure appeared at Hotel and Juliett. Golf had no new signals in the supplied release set.

FIXTURE GOLF CAPITAL CORP
- No new signals were provided in this release set.

FIXTURE HOTEL SENIOR LENDING
- Pinecrest Learning Group Inc. first lien term loan maturity was extended to 2031-09-30 from 2029-09-30, a 24-month extension that exceeds the 6-month threshold (accession 0009000012-26-000121, row 105; prior row 505).
- Brightwater Fitness Holdings LLC first lien term loan was marked to 93.5 from 99.0, a 5.5-point markdown that meets the materiality threshold (accession 0009000012-26-000121, row 101; prior row 501).
- Oakmont Home Services LLC first lien term loan PIK increased to 3.0 from 1.0, a 2.0-point rise above the 0.5-point threshold (accession 0009000012-26-000121, row 104; prior row 504).

FIXTURE JULIETT LENDING BDC
- Crestline Roofing Holdings LLC first lien term loan was marked to 90.0 from 97.5, a 7.5-point markdown above threshold (accession 0009000014-26-000141, row 103; prior row 503).
- Foxglove Specialty Pharma Inc. first lien term loan added PIK at 2.5 from 0.0, a 2.5-point increase above threshold (accession 0009000014-26-000141, row 106; prior row 506).

Bottom line
- 5 material signals across 2 held BDCs.
- Hotel showed one maturity extension, one markdown, and one higher-PIK position in accession 0009000012-26-000121.
- Juliett showed one markdown and one new PIK position in accession 0009000014-26-000141.
- Golf had no new supplied signals this month.

Coverage
- This draft covers the three HSERS-held BDCs named in scope. Filing citations included: accession 0009000012-26-000121 rows 105, 101, 104; accession 0009000014-26-000141 rows 103, 106.
